reviews.text:
I had such a great experience with this company! From my very first phone conversation with Sharon, I felt comfortable and confident trusting them. It was my first time having someone I didn’t know come into my home to take care of my cat, so I was a little nervous at first, but everything was very professional and well organized from beginning to end.

After every visit, I received a detailed report and updates, which gave me so much peace of mind while I was away. I was extremely satisfied with their service and will definitely use them again in the future. Highly recommend!
Fantastic sitters who always do a great job.
This pet sitting service is excellent.

They did an excellent job with my high energy dog Neo! He's a Doberman/German Shepherd mix who requires a lot of time and energy, they took him on an amazing walk that brought him back sooo tired!
Definitely recommend!
Thank you so much we love taking care of your family! Looking forward to seeing them again soon!

Valley Pet Sitting provided exception pet sitting services for my two cats. Jordan and Matt were professional, on time, and showed much care towards my animals. The attention to detail Valley Pet Sitting provides on their services gave me peace of mind my animals were okay when I was away. I could not recommend Valley Pet Sitting any higher!

They are awesome, they are punctual, reliable, and safe.  They have been watching my dogs for years and I have never had a problem.  Their people seem like they really enjoy the work, my dogs seem to like them and I feel safe with them in my house watching my animals.

Overall our experience with Valley Pet Sitting was wonderful. We are an older couple, therefore the initial sign up was somewhat daunting, but for younger folks it would be undoubtedly slick. Our sitters were excellent and the daily photo updates, along with description of tasks done, was reassuring. When they refer to themselves as "full service" they do mean it. From watering plants to mail to having fun with (in our case) our cat, this being all inclusive is for a very reasonable price.

My wife and I adopted a few kittens last summer, and we knew we'd need a reliable pet sitter to take care of our sweet fur babies whenever we leave town.  I found VPS on Google, and it has been a great experience so far!  We've used the service on four separate occasions and have been very impressed.  They're very professional, and we know we can depend on them to take care of the kitties' needs while we're gone.  Their website and app make it easy to schedule appointments, pay the bill, and--best of all--see the daily journal updates from the pet sitters.  The sitters take lots of pictures and give you written updates which not only give you peace of mind, but are also very entertaining!  If you live in the Valley and need a dependable pet sitter, I highly recommend Valley Pet Sitting.

The walkers and office staff at Valley Petsitting have done a great job with my dog. The software they use gives me a detailed report of the walks and the office staff is always available to answer questions.

Valley Pet Sitting is the best. They went out of their way to accommodate my suddenly-changed schedule and had a wonderful sitter over my place to watch my two Shar-Peis in one hour. I thought it would never happen, but they did it. And I am so grateful.

Excellent, professional, caring service! I've used Valley Pet Sitting several times to care for my cat while on vacation. My cat, Sketch, is elderly (19 years old) and needs special care to ensure her good health. Shira and her team did a great job from the first moment. They sent a seasoned sitter, Jillian, to meet with Sketch and me to learn about Sketch's unique needs and to establish a relationship with both of us before I left Sketch in their care the first time. Jillian was great! I immediately felt comfortable with her, and Sketch took to her instantly. Jillian obviously loves animals and has a calm, caring, competent demeanor. While on vacation, I received a daily update on each visit and pictures of Sketch to soothe my worrying mind (it's hard to trust an elderly animal to someone else's care!). Jillian and the entire VPS team were easily accessible whenever I had concerns. They are great communicators and very detail-oriented. VPS does an excellent job, and the cost for their service is very reasonable, given the high quality of care they deliver.

BUYER BEWARE!

If you care for your precious animal, do not use this service.  I used them under the guise that they were a reputable and decent pet service, particularly for dog walking.  I hired Valley Pet Sitting to walk our dog on January 16th and 17th.  We were in need as I live far away and my partner was sick and in need of a dog walker on the fly.

I called and requested service and they were able to provide someone quickly who they stated was "one of their best".  The dog walker, Lexi, walked our dog, but on the 17th, that walk ended in tragedy.  Our dog had a history of seizures, which Lexi was aware of.  At the end of the walk, our precious puppy suffered a major seizure lasting 4 minutes.  Lexi apparently looked after our dog during the seizure and timed it, but di not communicate the seriousness of the seizure, only that one occurred but that she took care of it.

Further, the seizure was not noted in the dog walking journals anywhere, but rather, communicated a very rosy portrait of the walk.  So I did not know one occurred until my partner told me that one occurred.  Our dogs health deteriorated and we had to take him to the emergency Verterinary hospital where our dog was treated.  Unfortunately it was too late and quickly thereafter, our precious puppy passed away due to the ongoing seizures.

there was a clear lack of communication when our dog was suffering a medical emergency that we had no idea was happening because of how it was downplayed by the dog walker.

This is a serious issue and one where I've filed a formal complaint with he business.  Be very careful entrusting your precious animal babies to this place.
They were really great with my dog. Him being an old and in need of consistent care was very happy with them. I am definitely going to use their service more often.

We have been using Valley Pet Sitting for 5... maybe 6 years. They are the best. I really cannot state how comforted I am to have them take care of our cats and dog when we are away. I feel safe with them in my home as well. They are respectful, prompt, kind, easy to work with. A+ all around.

I have been fortunate to have the services of Valley Pet Sitting for the past two years.  They have helped me in regular petsitting and short notice situations, in both LA and Ventura counties. …
Scarlett of Valley Pet Sitting took care of our two cats while we were away. Not only was she terrific with them but the entire organization is far and above #1 in pet setting.
